title: Hydrogen in toroidal confinement
summary: How does toroidal geometry change a confined hydrogenic system? A developing study of Coulomb-bound states, boundary conditions and a proposed extension to attosecond driving.
progress: Mathematical formulations and preliminary calculations are documented. The numerical results still require reproducible run configurations and convergence checks.
nextStep: Reproduce the field-free model, fix the geometry and Coulomb-centre convention, and test grid convergence before adding a pulse.

title: Attosecond-driven electron dynamics
summary: A study plan for electronic transitions under finite electromagnetic pulses, beginning with solvable models and independently reproducible benchmarks.
progress: Benchmark selection and modelling assumptions are being defined; a validated time-dependent simulation is not yet available.
nextStep: Benchmark a weak-field hydrogen transition or driven oscillator, then check time-step stability and conservation of probability.

title: Positive geometry & canonical forms
summary: Expository notes on canonical forms, boundary residues, positive Grassmannians and the mathematical route to the amplituhedron.
progress: Learning notes with interval and triangle examples are available. They synthesize established literature and are not presented as original research.
nextStep: Check boundary orientations and residues, then work through a nontrivial Grassmannian example.

title: Differential equations & spectral methods
summary: Building analytical and numerical foundations in ODEs, PDEs, Sturm–Liouville problems, Green functions and finite-difference methods.
progress: Study notes and a benchmark-oriented research plan are available; comparative numerical results remain a development goal.
nextStep: Reproduce the heat equation with constant diffusivity and check mesh convergence before studying variable diffusivity.

title: Symbolic quantum mechanics
summary: Designing a Mathematica workflow for checking operator identities, eigenvalue equations, special functions and normalization integrals.
progress: The symbolic workflow is scoped in the research registry. Public reproducible notebooks are a planned deliverable.
nextStep: Build a notebook that verifies oscillator commutators and hydrogen radial states, with explicit assumptions and residual checks.

title: Quantum Mechanics From Scratch
summary: An open-source interactive atlas of 41 foundational papers and milestones, tracing quantum mechanics from Planck to Bell.
progress: The atlas source includes paper summaries, central equations, source links, search, era filters and a browser-local reading tracker.
nextStep: Continue checking source links and expand the accompanying derivation and reproduction notes as they are completed.
